objective: Bring the Moss-twined Heart to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.

description: The heart of Blackmoss the Fetid is covered with a dark, oily moss.  In fact, the only way to tell this is a heart is from its slow, rhythmic beat... A beat that continues even now.
Perhaps Denalan will want to see this heart.
completion: ...What is this? A timberling heart?? It's covered with a foul moss!
Thank you for bringing this to me, <name>. I will examine the heart and, if fortune shines, determine the nature of the moss about it.
